feature_distance: cosine distance in same-fold same-class corrected Stage3R OOF feature space
band_lower_rule: q05 of real nearest-neighbor distance normalized by instance k5 radius

band_upper_rules.conservative: q75 of all real top5-neighbor normalized relations
band_upper_rules.medium: q90 of all real top5-neighbor normalized relations
band_upper_rules.wide: q95 of all real top5-neighbor normalized relations

normalization_selection_rule: Choose global if its mean pairwise class Wasserstein is within 10% of the best; otherwise class-adaptive if within 10% of instance-adaptive; otherwise instance-adaptive
instability_rule: REAL_MANIFOLD_TOO_UNSTABLE iff any class has fewer than 11 instances in a fold or at least four classes have k5-radius CV > 1.0
